[[File:Paul Willworth portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Paul Willworth.]]
'''Paul Willworth''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 99 from Monmouth, Oregon. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />
